thread:
alex: Auditor Claire asked for a compact bundle proving Q1 RBAC changes tied to KMS rotations and the CVE-2025-0421 triage. They want verifiable checksums, performed_by attribution, and a brief control mapping to SOC2/ISO.

priya: Window is 2025-01-01 -> 2025-03-31. I can pull CloudTrail slices and a Splunk export. Will include saved search id: sec_rbac_kms_q1.

sam: KMS rotation artifacts: rotation job rot-20250214 writes fingerprints at gs://redwood-ops/rotations/2025-02-14/fp.json and rotation metadata in audit-logs-prod. Envelope metadata includes keyVersionId and keyFingerprint.

auditor_claire: Please ensure each file has sha256, generated_by, generation_ts, and a short note tying it to a control (e.g., CC6.1, A.9.2). Also need proof that old key material was retired.

alex: We'll produce a GPG-signed manifest with file checksums and performed_by fields. For key retirement proof, rotation job emits a retiredKeyId entry and we include the fingerprint file plus the runbook excerpt RB-ROT-2025.

priya: Splunk query I'll export: `index=cloudtrail (eventName=UpdateRole OR eventName=DeleteRole OR eventName=AttachRolePolicy) | transaction userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName maxspan=1h | search (eventName=AssumeRole OR eventName=GetObject) | table _time, userIdentity, eventName, srcIP, resources` and save CSV to s3://redwood-security/evidence/2025-Q1/rbac_changes_slice.csv

sam: Deprovs are in deprovs_2025Q1.csv (columns: ts, actor, target_sa, ticket). The automation job iam-auto performed svc-ingest-archiver deprov on 2025-02-15. Ticket SEC-7821.

auditor_claire: Also need SIEM alert IDs that show any suspicious sessions after role changes.

alex: I'll include alert list: ALERT-20250212-07, ALERT-20250215-42 and a short correlation table. We'll produce evidence bundle evidence-q1-2025-rbac-kms.tar.gz at s3://redwood-security/evidence/2025-Q1/bundles/ and upload evidence-manifest.json.sig.

ci-bot: export-job started: id=exp-1775008888-01 status=running

priya: I'll add saved_search config saved_search_sec_rbac_kms_q1.json and audit_commands.txt (exact commands used).

sam: Fingerprints sample: { "keyName": "projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rlk/cryptoKeys/qlk", "keyVersion": "2", "fingerprint": "b1c2d3e4f5...", "retiredKeyId": "qlk-v1" } full file in bundle.

auditor_claire: Who will attest to the rotation? Need a named approver or service account owner in the manifest.

alex: I'll add `performed_by` entries: rotation-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com and signed attestation by @sam. Also will map files to controls in control_map.csv.

priya: Auditors need read access for 72 hours. I'll create a presigned URL and post it to the private audit channel when upload finishes.

ci-bot: export-job completed: id=exp-1775008888-01 status=success path=s3://redwood-security/evidence/2025-Q1/bundles/evidence-q1-2025-rbac-kms.tar.gz sha256=fa3b2c...

auditor_claire: Thanks. Once we get the presigned link and the signed manifest we'll proceed with review. Short mapping paragraphs per control will speed things up.

alex: noted, attaching concise mapping in control_map.csv and README on verification steps. Will post presigned link to private audit room now.
